verdict.rationale: Paddle is a SaaS billing/checkout platform, not an agent or agent-host application; the evidence shows Paddle offers an MCP *server* for other agents (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to connect to and use its tools, which is the reverse role. There is no evidence Paddle itself has an agent core that plugs in external MCP servers to consume their tools, so this client-side axis is a category error for this product type.
